newsitem.title: USA: Maine property tax cap supporters seek petition.
newsitem.headline: Maine property tax cap supporters seek petition.

text.p: A taxpayers group in Maine that supports a proposed property tax cap said it has enough signatures to force the legislature to consider the proposal.
A similar petition effort by the Maine Taxpayers Action Network failed a year ago amid charges of massive fraud.
Two months ago, the group's leader Carol Palesky, was indicted on aggravated forgery charges. But Palesky said the issue is more important than the charges against her.
On Tuesday, the group submitted more than 44,000 signatures to the Secretary of State for a measure, which seeks to hold annual increases in property taxes to one percent.
It is expected to take the state officials several days to review the validity of the petition signatures.
